items.name: compare-curtain
items.title: Compare Curtain
items.description: A draggable divider that reveals two aligned images or design states.

useCases: Before-and-after images, design revisions, and visual product comparisons.
limitations: Horizontal comparison only. The caller supplies aligned layers with matching dimensions.
requirements: Requires React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4. Supply accessible descriptions for images inside each layer. The divider supports pointer, touch, and keyboard input.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/compare-curtain.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: peel-stack
items.title: Peel Stack
items.description: A layered paper stack that rotates through collections with buttons, arrow keys, or a swipe.

useCases: Layered collections, portfolio studies, and attachment cards with manual navigation.
limitations: Shows up to three visible layers. Cards have a fixed height; increase it for long content. Demo artwork is not installed.
requirements: Supply items with unique IDs. Uses React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, and theme tokens. Inactive cards are inert; reduced motion disables transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/peel-stack.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: ascii-morph
items.title: ASCII Morph
items.description: A cloud of characters that morphs into a globe, a flower, and an A1 monogram.

useCases: Interactive ASCII illustrations for landing pages, portfolios, and identity studies.
limitations: Three built-in silhouettes only: globe, flower, and A1. Does not convert images or arbitrary text into ASCII.
requirements: React and Tailwind CSS. Uses SVG, requestAnimationFrame, matchMedia, and IntersectionObserver. Reduced motion switches shapes instantly. No automatic animation or pause control is needed.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/ascii-morph.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: ascii-lens
items.title: ASCII Lens
items.description: An image rendered as ASCII, with a circular lens that reveals the original.

useCases: Portfolio and product cards that reveal source artwork through an interactive lens.
limitations: Remote images must allow canvas pixel reads through CORS; otherwise ASCII sampling falls back to the original image.
requirements: Supply an image URL and alt text. Requires Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, and IntersectionObserver. Remote images need anonymous CORS permission for ASCII sampling.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/ascii-lens.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: integration-hub
items.title: Integration Hub
items.description: A connected workspace with six tools and animated pulses flowing into a central product.

useCases: Product integration diagrams with up to six tools, inward pulses, and optional tool selection.
limitations: Visualization only. No account connections, synchronization, or live activity data. Extra tools beyond six are ignored.
requirements: Supply tools with unique IDs and a product. Icons are React nodes. Supply a pause control for automatic motion. Reduced motion retains static connections.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/integration-hub.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: ascii-terrain
items.title: ASCII Terrain
items.description: A landscape made of characters, with rolling hills, pointer sculpting, and click ripples.

useCases: Interactive ASCII landscapes and decorative hero backgrounds.
limitations: Procedural illustration only. No geographic data or persistent terrain editing. JavaScript is required to draw.
requirements: Supply a pause control for automatic motion. Requires Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, and IntersectionObserver. Reduced motion shows a static landscape.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/ascii-terrain.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: text-banner
items.title: Text Banner
items.description: Bold text and staggered pixel separators in a seamless, infinitely scrolling banner.

useCases: Continuously scrolling words or phrases with separators for page banners.
limitations: Plain text only. Repeated content is decorative and cannot contain links or controls.
requirements: Supply items and a pause control using the paused prop. Requires ResizeObserver. Reduced motion displays one static sequence.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/text-banner.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: confirmation-button
items.title: Confirmation Button
items.description: A drag-to-confirm button with a dotted arrow, pending feedback, and a confirmed state.

useCases: Deliberate confirmation actions with drag, keyboard, and asynchronous feedback.
limitations: The app supplies the action. Dragging is left to right, and success stays visible until remount.
requirements: Requires React 19.2 or later. Supply onConfirm. Return a promise for asynchronous work and reject it to allow retry. Change the React key to reset.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/confirmation-button.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: shape-flow
items.title: Shape Flow
items.description: Text that reflows around a floating ASCII duck, powered by Pretext.

useCases: Editorial text wrapping around a floating ASCII duck.
limitations: One left-to-right plain-text paragraph. Rich text and right-to-left flow are unsupported.
requirements: Use a loaded named font. Interactive layout needs Canvas 2D, Intl.Segmenter, and ResizeObserver.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/shape-flow.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble
items.description: Reveals new text from left to right through a scramble of random characters.

useCases: Animating changing headings, labels, or status text through scrambled characters.
limitations: The initial text does not animate. Animation starts when the text prop changes.
requirements: Update the text prop to animate. Use a monospace font to reduce width shifts.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/text-scramble.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: section-rail
items.title: Section Rail
items.description: A compact reading rail that tracks progress through page sections.

useCases: Table of contents and reading progress for long pages with sections.
limitations: Tracks existing DOM sections; it does not create the page content.
requirements: Match every item ID to a section element on the page.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/section-rail.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: spiral-text
items.title: Spiral Text
items.description: Text set on a responsive spiral that tightens under pressure and ripples on release.

useCases: Decorative spiral typography with pointer interaction.
limitations: A decorative text composition, not a reading paragraph or changing-label effect.
requirements: Supply text and room for the responsive spiral.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/spiral-text.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: particle-menu
items.title: Particle Menu
items.description: Grainy symbols that scatter around your pointer and spring back into place.

useCases: Artistic navigation with interactive particle symbols.
limitations: A specialized visual navigation treatment, not a general dropdown selector.
requirements: Supply labeled items with supported shapes and navigation destinations.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/particle-menu.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: arc-reel
items.title: Arc Reel
items.description: An infinitely looping reel with curved provider cards and synchronized scroll controls.

useCases: Looping galleries, provider cards, or logo reels with drag and keyboard controls.
limitations: Supply your own artwork; demo images are not installed.
requirements: Theme tokens --background, --foreground, --border, and --muted-foreground must exist.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/arc-reel.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: A copy button that animates its icon and label into a checkmark and copied confirmation.

useCases: Copying text, links, and code with animated success feedback.
limitations: Copies plain text only. Clipboard access requires HTTPS or localhost and browser permission.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Phosphor icons. Supply value. Reduced motion skips the transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/copy-button.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: loading-button
items.title: Loading Button
items.description: A loading button with animated icon and label transitions for async actions and network requests.

useCases: Submitting data, saving changes, and running network requests with loading, success, and retry feedback.
limitations: Runs the supplied action on click. Does not submit forms automatically or cancel requests. Success resets after two seconds.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Phosphor icons. Supply onClick and return its promise. Throw or reject on failure, including non-OK fetch responses. Reduced motion skips transitions and spinner rotation.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/loading-button.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: Confirm Button
items.description: A hold-to-confirm button with a directional color fill and configurable hold duration.

useCases: Deliberate confirmation actions that require an uninterrupted pointer or keyboard hold.
limitations: onConfirm fires once per completed hold. The caller handles asynchronous work and errors. Confirmation stays visible for two seconds after release before resetting. Click-only activation does not confirm.
requirements: React 19.2 or later, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, Phosphor icons, and the shared UI Button. Supply onConfirm in a client component. duration is in seconds; direction is right, left, up, or down.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/confirm-button.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A shared highlight that travels between focused and selected menu items.

useCases: Sidebar navigation and view selectors with a traveling focus and selection highlight.
limitations: Selection is controlled by the caller. Each item needs a unique value. Keep item overflow visible so the highlight can travel between rows.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Base UI. Supply value and wrap each link or button with MenuItem. Reduced motion switches the highlight instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/menu.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A shadcn dropdown with open and close transitions and a traveling highlight.

useCases: Action menus with animated open and close transitions and a shared pointer and keyboard highlight.
limitations: Uses the shadcn Base UI variant. Animated highlights cover regular action items and submenu triggers; checkbox items and radio items use the underlying shadcn components.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, Base UI, and the shadcn Dropdown Menu. Reduced motion removes popup and highlight transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/dropdown-menu.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: icon-toggle
items.title: Icon Toggle
items.description: A two-state icon button that morphs its SVG paths on every click.

useCases: Icon toggles with a reversible morph between two states, such as menu and close or play and pause.
limitations: Custom path pairs must use matching SVG commands and coordinate counts in a 24 by 24 viewBox. Uses rounded strokes with no fill. Does not morph arbitrary React icon components.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and the shared UI Button. Supply a stable accessible label. Controlled usage requires updating pressed in onPressedChange. Reduced motion switches paths instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/icon-toggle.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider with magnetic stops that catch the thumb and pulse as you slide through them.

useCases: Adjusting values with magnetic catches at meaningful presets or unevenly spaced stops.
limitations: Horizontal single-thumb slider. Feedback is visual and does not vibrate the device. Dense stop labels can overlap.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Supply label and stops. Keyboard input bypasses magnetic snapping. Reduced motion removes animation and preserves snapping.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/slider.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time code field with 4, 6, or 8 slots, a traveling focus highlight, and characters that rise into place.

useCases: Entering numeric or alphanumeric verification, two-factor, and invite codes of 4, 6, or 8 characters.
limitations: Single row of 4, 6, or 8 slots. Edits happen at the end of the code; clicking a filled slot does not move the caret into it. Alphanumeric codes are uppercased.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Supply a label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes animation and keeps a static caret.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/otp-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: validated-input
items.title: Validated Input
items.description: A labeled text field that checks its value against a Zod schema and animates the error and success states.

useCases: Validating emails, usernames, URLs, and other single-line text fields with Zod in native forms.
limitations: Validates one field against a synchronous schema that accepts a string. Shows the first issue only. Cross-field and async checks belong to the caller.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Phosphor icons, Zod 4, and the shadcn input and label components. Supply label and schema. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes the shake and transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/validated-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A text field that collects multiple tags, with a two-step Backspace removal and an optional limit.

useCases: Collecting keywords, topics, skills, labels, or email recipients as a list of short tags in forms.
limitations: Tags are plain trimmed strings added at the end; duplicates are rejected case-insensitively. No suggestions, reordering, or inline editing of existing tags.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Phosphor icons, the shadcn label component, and theme colors. Supply a label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes the shake and transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/tag-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field that requires a strong password, with a strength meter that opens its requirements on hover, and a show/hide toggle.

useCases: Requiring a strong password in sign-up, password reset, and change-password forms, with a compact meter that reveals each requirement on hover.
limitations: Strength comes only from synchronous rules; there is no entropy estimate, breached-password lookup, or confirmation field. Every rule must pass for the field to be valid.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, Phosphor icons, and the shadcn input and label components. Supply a label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes the shake and transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/password-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a spring indicator that slides between triggers, a hover highlight, and direction-aware panels.

useCases: Switching between related views, such as dashboard sections or settings panes, where the active tab should feel connected to the last one.
limitations: Horizontal orientation only. Panels unmount when inactive. The underline variant expects one row of triggers.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give each TabsTrigger and TabsContent a matching string value and the list an aria-label. Reduced motion moves the indicator and swaps panels instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/tabs.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A switch whose thumb squashes on press, springs across the track, and can rotate icons in and out.

useCases: Settings that apply immediately, such as notifications or dark mode, with optional icons for the two states.
limitations: One size, 44 by 24 pixels. Thumb icons should be small glyphs about 12 pixels across.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Supply label or aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating checked in onCheckedChange. Reduced motion removes the squash and moves the thumb instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/switch.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that draws its check, morphs from an indeterminate dash, and can strike through its label.

useCases: Task lists, consent fields, and select-all groups where a parent shows a partial selection.
limitations: The strikethrough is a single 1px line drawn with a background gradient. Indeterminate state is controlled by the caller.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Supply label or aria-label. Clear indeterminate in onCheckedChange. Reduced motion draws the mark instantly and removes the burst.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/checkbox.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A radio group whose single dot slides from option to option, with a card variant whose highlighted border glides between cards.

useCases: Plan pickers, settings with a few mutually exclusive choices, and shipping or payment options shown as cards.
limitations: Values are strings. The card highlight scales between cards of different heights, so its border can stretch slightly mid-flight.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give the group aria-label or aria-labelledby, and each item a label or aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion moves the dot and highlight instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/radio-group.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A segmented control whose surface slides between items, or chips that pop in with a check when pressed.

useCases: Switching a view or alignment with a segmented control, or picking several filters as chips.
limitations: Single mode keeps one item pressed once chosen. Chips wrap onto new lines; the segmented track expects one row. Icon-only detection treats any item without text children as icon-only.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give each ToggleGroupItem a unique string value, the group an aria-label, and icon-only items an aria-label. Reduced motion moves the surface and presses chips instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/toggle-group.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: An accordion whose panels glide open to their natural height, stagger their content in, and turn a chevron or fold a plus into a minus.

useCases: FAQs, settings sections, and long forms where readers open one or several sections at a time.
limitations: Only direct child elements of AccordionContent stagger in; plain text fades as one block. Closed panels unmount, so browser find-in-page does not search them.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give every AccordionItem a unique value. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion opens panels instantly and skips the stagger.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/accordion.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A progress bar, ring, or step row whose fill springs to each value while the percentage rolls like a counter.

useCases: Uploads, onboarding checklists, quotas, and background jobs where a value changes over time or is not yet known.
limitations: Display only: the caller owns the value. The value text rolls digits 0 to 9 only, so other characters in formatValue output change instantly. The ring has one stroke width derived from its size.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Supply label or aria-label. Pass value={null} for indeterminate. Reduced motion jumps the fill, stops the sweep and shimmer, and swaps digits without rolling.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/progress.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that grows out of the button that opened it and shrinks back into it, over a blurred backdrop.

useCases: Focused tasks that interrupt the page, such as editing a profile, sharing a link, or confirming settings, where the dialog should feel connected to the button that opened it.
limitations: Modal only. One popup per Dialog. Below 640px it rises from the bottom edge instead of growing from the trigger. Use an alert dialog for destructive confirmations that must not close on an outside click.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give every DialogContent a DialogTitle. Reduced motion replaces the scale, slide, and blur with a short fade.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/dialog.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A confirmation dialog that springs in, shakes when you click outside it, and fades out before it unmounts.

useCases: Confirming destructive or irreversible actions such as deleting a project, signing out, or discarding unsaved changes.
limitations: One centered size capped at 28rem wide. Backdrop clicks never close it. Cancel and Action always close the dialog, so run async work before or after rather than inside the dialog.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors including destructive. Always include AlertDialogTitle and AlertDialogDescription. Controlled usage requires updating open in onOpenChange. Reduced motion opens and closes instantly and removes the shake.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/alert-dialog.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom or side sheet that springs in, follows your drag, rubber-bands, and can scale the page behind it.

useCases: Mobile-first forms, pickers, share sheets, and filter panels that slide up from the bottom or in from the right and dismiss with a drag.
limitations: Sides are bottom and right only, with no snap points. Dragging starts anywhere on the sheet except controls, so give scrollable regions data-drawer-no-drag. The scale effect only reaches content inside a DrawerScaleWrapper.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Include a DrawerTitle or pass aria-label to DrawerContent. Controlled usage requires updating open in onOpenChange. Reduced motion moves the sheet instantly and removes the rubber band.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/drawer.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toasts that stack as a deck, fan out on hover, and swipe away, with a loading state that morphs into success.

useCases: Save confirmations, errors, undo actions, and long-running uploads or deploys that resolve to success or failure.
limitations: Three toasts show in the collapsed deck. Swiping is horizontal only. Success and default share the foreground color; errors use the destructive color.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors including destructive. Wrap the app in ToastProvider and render one Toaster inside it. Reduced motion places toasts instantly and stops the spinner.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/toast.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip that springs from its trigger and glides between neighboring triggers, morphing its size and text.

useCases: Icon-button toolbars, editor controls, and dense action bars where hints should follow the pointer from button to button.
limitations: Tooltips inside one gliding TooltipProvider share a single popup, so only one shows at a time. Tooltip text is a hint for pointer and keyboard users; it is not announced on touch devices, so icon buttons still need an aria-label.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Wrap triggers in TooltipProvider to share delays and glide between them. Reduced motion shows and moves the tooltip instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/tooltip.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
